topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon an article online, and there, staring back at me, were words I thought I'd left behind in the draft folders of my youth. My college application essay, line by line, paragraph by paragraph, as crisp and detailed as the day I typed it. It was like encountering a younger self, one who had poured so much of themselves into every sentence, hoping to catch the eye of admissions committees. Now, here it was, not just read by those committees, but shared for others to see, a snapshot of my hopes and fears, laid out in the open. The world has a way of circling back, doesn’t it?
